costsFaq.q: How do I find out about legal fees?
costsFaq.a: Ask Adam to explain the proposed scope of work, costs and payment arrangements before engaging the firm. Fees depend on the circumstances and work required; this website does not quote a fee.

disclaimer: General information, not legal advice. An enquiry does not create a lawyer–client relationship. Liability limited by a scheme approved under Professional Standards Legislation. Landscape photography of the Tweed Valley is used under Creative Commons licences.
admission: Admitted to the Supreme Courts of NSW and Queensland
